name: inkwell
description: A PDF reader and annotator with a pressure-sensitive ink engine
author: Adion52330

scripts.test:export: node scripts/make-sample.js && esbuild scripts/test-export.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/test-export.mjs --log-level=warning && node dist/test-export.mjs sample/sample.pdf dist/export-test.pdf && python3 scripts/check-export.py dist/export-test.pdf
scripts.test:live-stroke: node scripts/test-live-stroke.mjs --out dist/live-stroke && python3 scripts/check-live-stroke.py dist/live-stroke
scripts.test: npm run test:export && npm run test:live-stroke && npm run test:objects && npm run test:zoom && npm run test:unsaved && npm run test:text && npm run test:sidebar

linux.description: Open PDFs and write on them with a pressure-sensitive pen, highlighter, shapes and notes. Ink is stored beside the file so the original PDF is never modified.
